implementation: Asset GET cache-open or cache-read failure falls back to network.
Successful response is not blocked by asynchronous or synchronous cache write failures; worker lifetime covers the caught write promise.
A network TypeError before a response receives one 120ms bounded retry. A second failure propagates. HTTP errors and aborted requests are not retried.
Non-GET requests are not intercepted. No wager, payment, account, equipment or model changes.
limits: Incident cause is unconfirmed. The patch addresses independently identified storage fragility and transient rejected GETs, not a proven explanation of the production incident.
A retry cannot repair persistent connectivity, invalid content, or a response body failure after delivery.
Authored-model fallback does not count as authored acceptance; strict browser failure collection is unchanged.
No production credentialed replay or broad campaign run was performed locally.
